description: Infrastructures de recharge pour (organisation Installation d'une borne 22KWA Parking entrepôt ) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Installation d'une borne 22KWA Parking entrepôt . This dataset meets the specifications of the diagram "Charging infrastructure for electric vehicles" available on the website schema.data.gouv.fr. Coverage: a charging station at za banarge, Duras. The portal shows the English title as "Charging infrastructure for electric vehicles (organisation Installation of a terminal 22KWA Parking warehouse )" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Installation d'une borne 22KWA Parking entrepôt . The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
